condition: read_csv with index_col and a dtype applies that dtype to the index for most dtypes (e.g. 'string[pyarrow]', float) but not for str/object, and read_excel never applies it, so the index dtype changes depending on which dtype you pass.
workaround: After reading, set the index dtype explicitly (e.g. df.index = df.index.astype(...)). Or use dtype_backend="pyarrow" so the index and the columns both get Arrow dtypes.
